key_insight: GGPO learns from off-policy responses using a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards, avoiding learner-to-behavior importance weights that can have high variance on long responses.
engineering_relevance: GGPO offers a way to train mathematical-reasoning models on stale or fixed offline responses with verifiable rewards.
method: Contrast KL-adjusted rewards across responses to the same prompt.
Minimize a loss whose on-policy population form equals the KL-regularized optimality gap.
Refresh the reference policy, supported by Gibbs-target composition and finite-data analysis.
evidence_signal: Math-reasoning experiments report gains over GRPO and AGRO under training–inference mismatch and on fixed offline data; reference refresh raises the five-benchmark problem-weighted average from 32.96 to 46.58.
watch_item: Reward guarantees require suitable coverage and mismatch-control assumptions, and the refresh ablation shows substantial sensitivity to reference-policy management.
paper_title: Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards
